# Planar_Network_Generation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Algorithms for generating planar networks that simulate hierarchical structures, relevant to both network topology and neural connectivity. Enables design of efficient, planar interconnect topologies for TCC and biologically plausible network architectures for iNEST.
